description: This file contains implementations of matrix and vector operations optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including dot product, vector dot, and matrix-vector multiplication, with checks, caching, and device-specific handling.

classes.name: MPSCachedGraph
classes.description: Base class for caching MPS computation graphs, with stored tensor references.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: Derived caching class with specific tensor members for matrix-vector addition.

methods.name: dot_check
methods.description: Checks that input tensors are 1D, have matching data types, sizes, and reside on the same device.

methods.name: dot_mps
methods.description: Computes the dot product of two 1D tensors using MPS, with caching and device-specific handling.

methods.name: vdot_mps
methods.description: Computes the vector dot product, including conjugation for complex tensors, using MPS.

methods.name: addmv_out_mps_impl
methods.description: Performs matrix-vector multiplication and addition with optional broadcasting, optimized for MPS.
